scenario_results.scenario: Multi-turn aid-status and simulated service ticket
inputs: 我想查询我的助学申请进度。
我的申请记录编号是 SIM-REC-001。
请帮我为这条助学申请创建一个模拟人工服务单，咨询预计审核完成时间。
scenario_results.observed: The agent asks for the missing record ID, returns SIM-REC-001 status 材料审核中 with update time 2026-09-28 10:00, then creates SIM-TICKET-4dceb292097e5718 linked to SIM-REC-001 and says it will not contact or trigger real staff.

scenario_results.input: 请问长安大学图书馆今天各馆区分别几点开门、几点闭馆？
scenario_results.observed: Refuses to confirm specific hours because the retrieved official snapshot only lists a notice title and not its body; suggests the library official site and public contact channels.

scenario_results.input: 请问长安大学图书馆的联系电话和联系邮箱是什么？请给出资料来源。
scenario_results.observed: Returns +86-029-82334372 and tsgbgs@chd.edu.cn with official library homepage snapshot, URL and 2026-10-06 capture date.

scenario_results.input: 长安大学本科生每学期修读的必修课和选修课学分一般以多少为宜？请说明超出后的要求并标明来源。
scenario_results.observed: Returns 15–35 credits as the general range; over 35 (over 45 for supplementary major) requires advisor consent, college review and Academic Affairs approval; cites the 2022 trial notice and says current validity requires confirmation.
